name: Gerhardt KT-8s Digestion System for Kjeldahl Nitrogen/Protein Analysis - Alat Destruksi Protein with Dummy Tube
description:
Kjeldaltherm - Digestion Unit, with 8 digestion tubes, 300 ml. Precise temperature control permits the conditions for the digestions to be optimized thus providing reproducible results. Digestion block made of aluminium with holes for digestion tubes. Energy efficient heating and insulation to retain heat within the block. Insert rach made of aluminium with integrated heat shield and window provide easy and safe observation of the samples. Exhaust system with heat insulated handles, integrated glass exhaust manifold and water jet pump. Exhaust system and digestion tubes can be easily and safety handles separately. Two-tier console mounted directly on the block. The insert rach as well as the exhaust manifold can be stored safely, above the block during the cooling down periods. This has a positive impact on the safe operation of the kjeldaltherm and at the same time, saves bench space. Excess temperature protectin as well as an excess current switch for safety. Working with the temperature time controller TZ ensures the fully automated process after programming the temperature time steps.

name: LC Tech DEXTech Pure PCB & Dioxin for Sample Clean-up Preparation - Alat Preparasi Analisis Dioksin Full Set Ready to Use
description:
DEXTech Pure adalah solusi standar bagi pengguna dalam analisis dioksin / PCB. Alat ini berhasil digunakan di seluruh dunia dalam analisis pangan dan pakan serta dalam analisis lingkungan. Bahkan sampel dengan tingkat kontaminasi tinggi dapat diproses tanpa adanya kontaminasi silang (carry-over).

Tidak ada kontaminasi sisa (carry-over), tidak ada kontaminasi silang (cross-contamination), dan tidak ada penyumbatan pada kolom. Cukup masukkan sampel ke dalam sistem, pasang kolomnya, dan mulai prosesnya!

DEXTech dapat digunakan untuk berbagai macam metode. Metode bawaan (default) telah mematuhi semua standar terkini seperti US-EPA 8282B, US-EPA 1613, US-EPA 1668c, regulasi komisi EU (EC) No 589/214, No 1881/2006, No 152/2009, No 2002/32, GOST 34449-2018, dan standar lainnya.

Fitur unggulan:
- Proven Electric & Safe Locking System: No screwing of columns - easy one hand operation
- Ready to use click in consumable columns, with reusable activated carbon column for increased efficiency up to 30%
- Cost optimized 2 column methods for PCB only and Dioxin only available
- Established method that separates mono-ortho-PCB + ndl-PCB + PBDE from non-ortho-PCB + PCDD/F
- No contact of sample and pump because of additional volume and air/solvent gap - no cross contamination
- Safety system: leakage detection, overpressure control, front door with safety shut-off, level sensor for waste
- Available method for DCM-free, less hazardous with optimized rinsing between the samples
- Ready to Use for 100 samples

• Advanced Software Integration

• Derivatization by spraying
• Reproducible and homogeneous reagent distribution with "Micro droplet" spraying technology
• Low reagent consumption (2-4 ml)
• Standalone instrument with a small footprint
• Suitable for plates and sheets up to 20x20 cm
• Environment and user-friendly due to the closed hood and wash bottle aspiration system

name: LC Tech DEXTech Heat Dioxin Sample Preparation for GC-MC Analysis - Alat Preparasi Dioksin
description:
DEXTech Heat adalah solusi untuk sampel-sampel sulit dalam analisis dioksin, furan, dan PCB. dan sangat ideal untuk sampel yang mengeras pada suhu ruangan. Sampel-sampel ini dapat dijaga agar tetap cair secara andal berkat teknologi pemanas zona khusus (zone heating technology), serta dapat diproses secara otomatis dan dibersihkan tanpa perlu diawasi. Ini mencakup sampel seperti lemak sawit, stearin, dan PFAD (Palm Fatty Acid Distillate).

Tidak ada kontaminasi sisa (carry-over), tidak ada kontaminasi silang (cross-contamination), dan tidak ada penyumbatan pada kolom. Cukup masukkan sampel ke dalam sistem, pasang kolomnya, dan mulai prosesnya!

DEXTech dapat digunakan untuk berbagai macam metode. Metode bawaan (default) telah mematuhi semua standar terkini seperti US-EPA 8282B, US-EPA 1613, US-EPA 1668c, regulasi komisi EU (EC) No 589/214, No 1881/2006, No 152/2009, No 2002/32, GOST 34449-2018, dan standar lainnya.

Fitur unggulan:
- Proven Electric & Safe Locking System: No screwing of columns - easy one hand operation
- Ready to use click in consumable columns, with reusable activated carbon column for increased efficiency up to 30%
- Cost optimized 2 column methods for PCB only and Dioxin only available
- Established method that separates mono-ortho-PCB + ndl-PCB + PBDE from non-ortho-PCB + PCDD/F
- No contact of sample and pump because of additional volume and air/solvent gap - no cross contamination
- Safety system: leakage detection, overpressure control, front door with safety shut-off, level sensor for waste

Key Features CAMAG ADC 3:
• Fully automated chromatogram development, • Integrated Twin Trough Chamber (20 x 10 cm), • Built-in humidity control for enhanced reproducibility, •	Software-controlled by visionCATS, • Compliance with cGMP/GLP and 21 CFR Part 11

name: CAMAG HPTLC Application and Densitometer Set Systems
description:
Camag Linomat 5 adalah alat semi-otomatis untuk aplikasi sampel (sample applicator) pada kromatografi lapis tipis (TLC / HPTLC). Camag Scanner 4 adalah densitometer, artinya alat untuk men-scan dan mengukur intensitas refleksi cahaya dari zat yang sudah dipisahkan di plat TLC/HPTLC.

Key Features CAMAG TLC Scanner 4:
•	Advanced Software Integration
•	Versatile Detection Capabilities
•	Multi-Wavelength and Multi-Step Evaluation: The combination of the TLC Scanner 4 and visionCATS allows for multi-wavelength scanning and multi-step evaluations, which improves differentiation and quantification of substances.
•	Data Integrity and Regulatory Compliance: comply with regulated environments like GLP and GMP, offering data integrity, audit trails, and traceability.
•	Faster, More Accurate Identification
•	Efficient Data Interpretation: Eliminate the need for manual spectrum analysis. Pearson correlation-based comparison allows analysts to rapidly interpret results.
•	Reliable Detection of Adulteration & Contaminants
•	Accelerated Research & Development

Key Features CAMAG Linomat 5:
•	Application Method: Applies samples using a spray technique.
•	Plate/Sheet Sizes: Compatible with plates and sheets measuring 20x20 cm, 20x10 cm, and 10x10 cm.
•	Manual Functions: Syringe cleaning, syringe filling, and syringe replacement must be performed manually.
•	Automatic Functions: Capable of automatic sample spraying to create homogeneous bands or spots in preprogrammed positions.
•	Control: Can be operated in a stand-alone mode or controlled by visionCATS software.
•	Syringe Volume: The standard syringe volume is 100 µL, with an optional 500 µL size available.

name: CAMAG Set Application and Documentation
description:
CAMAG Automatic TLC Sampler 4 adalah perangkat otomatis yang dirancang untuk aplikasi sampel presisi pada pelat TLC dan HPTLC. ATS 4 memastikan alur kerja yang efisien, sehingga ideal untuk analisis kualitatif dan kuantitatif di lingkungan laboratorium dengan throughput tinggi. TLC Visualizer 3 adalah sistem pencitraan dan dokumentasi kelas atas dengan kinerja unggul dalam cahaya putih, UV gelombang panjang (366 nm) dan UV gelombang pendek (254 nm) memastikan pencahayaan dengan homogenitas maksimum. Keduanya merupakan kombinasi yang pas untuk Analisa kuantitatif.				
				
Key Features CAMAG Automatic TLC Sampler 4:
•	Fully automated sample application
•	Application of bands, spots, or rectangles
•	Any plate format up to 20 x 20 cm
•	Spray-on application or contact transfer
•	Software-controlled by visionCATS
•	Heated Spray Nozzle (option)

Key Features CAMAG Visualizer 3:
•	Maximum illumination homogeneity in white light, UV 366 nm, and UV 254 nm.
•	High-performance industrial camera with CMOS image sensor
•	Powered by visionCATS HPTLC analysis software.
•	Various image enhancement tools for the detection of even the faintest zones.4
•	Side-by-side display of tracks from different plates.
•	Image-based evaluation.
•	Full compliance with cGMP/cGLP and 21 CFR Part 11

name: CAMAG Automatic Developing Chamber (ADC 3)
description:
Automatic Developing Chamber (ADC 3) adalah perangkat yang dirancang untuk melakukan eluasi plat secara konsisten dan sepenuhnya otomatis dalam analisis Kromatografi Lapis Tipis Kinerja Tinggi Tinggi (KLTK/HPTLC), guna mendukung reproduktivitas dan integritas data				

Key Features CAMAG ADC 3:
•	Fully automated chromatogram development
•	Integrated Twin Trough Chamber (20 x 10 cm)
•	Built-in humidity control for enhanced reproducibility
•	Software-controlled by visionCATS
•	Compliance with cGMP/GLP and 21 CFR Part 11
The six steps describe a process, likely for Thin-Layer Chromatography (TLC), focused on preparation and post-development steps for reproducible results:
1.	Pre-drying: Removes residual solvents from the plate after sample application using a controlled blower, ensuring optimal conditions for development.
2.	Chamber Saturation: Establishes a stable and consistent solvent vapor atmosphere inside the twin-trough chamber prior to development to ensure uniform vapor distribution.
3.	Pre-conditioning: Equilibrates the stationary phase by exposing it to solvent vapors in a controlled environment, which modifies the properties of the stationary phase.
4.	Plate Activation: Controls the humidity level (often using a saturated salt solution or molecular sieve) to ensure reproducible performance of the plate.
5.	Post-Development Drying: Dries the plate after development using a controlled blower to remove remaining mobile phase solvents, preparing it for detection or evaluation.
6.	Rinsing Procedure: Cleans the system (funnels or glass tank) when switching solvent systems to ensure a clean transition.

description:

•	Vessel Capacity: 8-position design.

•	Unattended Start: Can be configured for unattended automatic introduction of the dosage form when media reaches the user-specified temperature.
•	Optional Auto-Probes: Optional Auto-Probes automatically exit the vessels after sampling, which reduces hydrodynamic interference.
•	Security: Enhanced Security 
VISION G2 Features
•	Low Spindle Variation: Has a low variation in spindle speed (0.6 rpm max typical).
•	Heating System: Uses an independent Vision G2 heater circulator with low vibration and space-saving location.
•	Waterbath: Features a molded waterbath with fast heat-up and a low level drain.
•	Vessels: Includes rugged, chip-proof vessels.
•	Maintenance: Allows quick, no-tools-needed access to internal components for time-saving maintenance.
•	Temperature Monitoring: Comes with a hand-held digital temperature probe for vessels and the waterbath.
•	Customization
